description: Java source code for the InteropApiResource class, which defines REST API endpoints for interoperation functionalities such as account management, transactions, quotes, transfers, and KYC within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: InteropApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class providing endpoints for interoperation operations such as account info, transactions, quotes, transfers, and KYC.

methods.name: getAccountDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific account by accountId.

methods.name: getAccountTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transactions for a specific account, filtered by debit/credit and date range.

methods.name: getAccountIdentifiers
methods.description: Fetches secondary identifiers associated with an account.

methods.name: getAccountByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves account info using secondary identifiers.

methods.name: registerAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Registers a new secondary identifier for an account.

methods.name: deleteAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Deletes a secondary identifier from an account.

methods.name: getTransactionRequest
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific transaction request.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Retrieves a quote for a transaction.

methods.name: createQuote
methods.description: Creates a new quote for a transaction.

methods.name: performTransfer
methods.description: Performs a transfer action, such as initiate or cancel.

methods.name: getClientKyc
methods.description: Retrieves KYC information for an account.

methods.name: disburseLoan
methods.description: Disburses a loan to an account.
